assisted.explainerAfter: that a human approves, edits, or rejects in the AI Inbox.

assisted.enabledNote: Suggestions are generated on enabled channels. Review and send from the AI Inbox — nothing is sent without a human. A newer customer message blocks approving a stale suggestion (server-enforced).

messaging.label: Messaging
messaging.titleApprovalSend: Approving a draft sends a real message
messaging.titleAutoSend: Messages the customer the moment the size is back, with no review

confirm.enableApprovalSend: Enable APPROVAL_SEND? Approving a draft will send a real message to the customer through the connected channel. Drafting and approval still require a human; nothing is autonomous.
confirm.enableAutoSend: Enable AUTO SEND? From now on, the moment a size is back in stock a WhatsApp message goes to the customer immediately, with nobody reading it first. The guards remain: exact size only, and one message per customer per product per 14 days. You can switch back to Approval + Send at any time.
confirm.reject: Reject this draft? No message will be sent.
confirm.approveSend: Approve & Send this message to the customer now? This contacts the customer through the connected channel.
confirm.cancelIntent: Cancel this restock request? A future restock will not recover it.

banner.verifiedFacts: Drafts are generated from verified facts only.
banner.noSendUntil: No message is sent until a human clicks Approve & Send
banner.andOnlyWhen: and only when messaging mode is
banner.approvalSendOn: Approval + Send is ON — approving a draft contacts the customer.
banner.autoSendDetail: Messages go to customers the moment the size is back, with no human review. The drafts here are a record and an audit trail. The guards remain: exact size only, and one message per customer per product per 14 days.
